north_star: Give an offline agent a small, inspectable graph of public functional concepts while preserving evidence and uncertainty boundaries.
wedge: One JSON graph, one JSON Schema, a deterministic validator, and a query CLI that run with Python standard library only.
target_user: Agent builders and reviewers who need bounded James Software functional context without reproducing support content.
core_promise: Useful graph queries with source-pointer provenance, explicit fact/inference/unknown labels, and a mechanically enforced public payload boundary.
product_principles: Original synthesis over copied expression; selected source URLs over harvested content; unknowns stay unknown.
non_goals: No scraped corpus, article mirror, media index, raw downloads, private provenance, person data, API invention, or implementation-schema claims.
success_metrics: A fresh clone can validate and query the graph offline with no dependencies.
